breakingChangesNotes: According to the Bitbucket announcement from February 18, 2026, regarding the sunset of Bitbucket Issues, all issue-related commands have been deprecated. Bitbucket Cloud has deprecated app passwords (from **June 9, 2026**) in favor of scoped API tokens. For more information, see the [Bitbucket Cloud documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#app-passwords).
